products.title: Acorn 130 Straight Stairlift - Red
products.body_html:
If you’re looking for a straight stairlift which excels in comfort, practicality and convenience; then you don’t have to look further than the Acorn 130 T700 stairlift. A descendent of the original Acorn Superglide, the 130 has been refined and improved over the years to bring you the ultimate stairlift when it comes to comfort, safety and performance.

The Acorn 130 straight stairlift comes with a number of features to make you feel at ease when using the device, including having a 90° lockable swivel seat that allows for easy access getting on to and out of the stairlift. There are also safety sensors included to ensure that if something obstructs the stairlift, then it will stop its journey. The stairlift also features a diagnostic display to help you operate the Acorn 130, and has a remote control to allow you to operate it when it’s on a different floor. A back-up battery also ensures you can keep moving even if the first battery is depleted.

Easy installation is available through Multicare, which requires no structural changes to your home, and the Acorn 130 and its rail can be fitted quickly and easily to the stairs and not the wall. The slimline design and folding footrest means it can easily fold away when not in use, and the optional hinged rail design eliminates any obstruction or trip hazard, meaning the stairs are still easy to use for those that don’t require use of a stairlift. The Acorn 130 is an affordable and energy-efficient straight stairlift option with low running costs; and it also comes with a 2 year guarantee, protecting you in the unlikely event of a fault. The maximum capacity is 280lbs, which is 20 stone or 127kg, and a heavy-duty model has the capacity of 25 stone or 350lbs.

products.title: Handicare 1000 Perch Stairlift
products.body_html:
The 1000 Perch Stairlift is ideal for narrow staircases or users with limited mobility in the knees or hips; the perch stand-up stairlift will be the ideal solution. This model offers significant advantages and benefits for individuals with restricted movement or limited flexibility, providing a more comfortable and practical option compared to traditional seated stairlifts.

As a suitable alternative to standard seated stairlifts, the 1000 Perch Stairlift is especially beneficial for those who find sitting or standing difficult. The seat is higher and designed for a perched position, which reduces joint strain and supports users who have trouble bending their knees or hips. The main difference between perch stairlifts and seated models is that perch stairlifts allow users to be in a perched position rather than fully seated, making them ideal for people with restricted movement or flexibility challenges. 

Condition: Reconditioned

products.title: Platinum Ergo Stairlift
products.body_html:
THE ERGO


BY PLATINUM STAIRLIFTS

Do you have a straight staircase without any turns ? The Ergo straight stairlift is the ideal choice for you. The installation is quick and simple, allowing you to get back to enjoying the home you love. The installer will do a straightforward assessment, counting the number of steps and measuring the width; at this point, there will be no obligation to buy. The ergo range comes with a choice of 4 coloured seats to suit your style and complement your décor. Other customisable options will ensure you have a smooth and comfortable ride. This straight model can also be used outdoors, engineered to withstand all weather conditions; it is a perfect solution for an external staircase leading up to your house or even just a few steps down to the garden.

products.title: Platinum Ultimate Curved Stairlift
products.body_html: The Platinum Ultimate stairlift is an impressive smart curved stairlift, which is ideal for staircases that were previously unsuitable for stairlifts. This new, unique stairlift offers a smart first step and single tube rail without hinges, making it different to other stairlifts on the market. This Platinum stairlift can come with a range of features including a few optional extras to suit your home and allow you to make the most out of your curved stairlift. They include custom rail colours and upholstery colours to match your home’s current aesthetics, and technological features such as a powered swivel seat and a flush finish. There is also a heavy-duty version of this Platinum curved stairlift available which has a carriage which can carry up to 25 stone in weight (equivalent to 160kg or 350lbs). The standard version is able to carry up to 19 stone (which is 120kg or 264lbs). You can find an impressive number of features to make the stairlift easy to use, including a choice of controls and an adjustable seat, armrests and footrests to suit the user. The Platinum Ultimate curved stairlift ticks a number of boxes when it comes to stairlifts, with it being curved, suitable for narrow stairs and also available in a heavy duty model. It’s just one of the Platinum stairlifts available at Multicare Mobility, including the Platinum Curve Stairlift.

products.body_html:
Welcome to the Platinum Ergo Curve stairlift. A smooth and comfortable 
twin-rail stairlift, ideal for curved staircases with an ergonomic chair that 
is fully adjustable to you. The Platinum Ergo Curve stairlift offers you the ideal combination of function and comfort, letting you enjoy living in the home you love. Its

products.title: Flow X Stairlift
products.body_html:
The Flow X is the latest innovation in stairlifts from Access BDD. Featuring a stylish and ergonomic design, the chair has a large backrest and seat area. The Flow X is an ergonomically designed lift that supports both sitting and standing transfers, featuring armrests that provide essential support during these movements. The stairlift also has a five-degree seat recline, promoting a natural and healthy posture whilst making you feel more comfortable and secure when travelling up and down stairs. The armrests also feature an ergonomic design, and the controls on them are very easy to use. The joystick features a comfortable soft-touch grip and can fold away neatly into the Flow X armrest. There is also a call device on one of the armrests that allows the user to stay connected with friends and family, with three telephone numbers being directly contactable from the Flow X stairlift. The Flow X includes an optional integrated call device in the armrest, programmable to call up to three telephone numbers contactable directly.

The seatbelt on the Flow X can be operated with one hand, meaning you can easily secure yourself in your seat. The seatbelt includes a detection system to ensure the user is properly secured before the stair lift operates, and the armrests must be in the correct position for the stair lift to function. The armrest also wraps around you to keep you secure and comfortable throughout your journey.

The Advanced Swivel and Levelling Technology (ASL) is unique to the Flow X stairlift, which allows the stairlift to rotate while in motion and can be fitted on staircases as narrow as 610mm (or 24 inches). The Flow X is distinguished by its ability to auto-swivel during travel, ensuring users are positioned at the safest angle. The footrest is adjustable, linked to the seat, and features an anti-slip surface for safety. The discrete single rail design also ensures your stairlift is less obtrusive and your staircase remains accessible to friends or family members. The Flow X features a space-saving design with a single rail fitted to the stairs and automatic folding of the seat, armrests, and footrest, minimising the footprint on the floor and reducing trip hazards.

Condition: Reconditioned

The Flow X stairlift is battery-powered, continues to operate during power outages, and the batteries recharge when parked.

The Flow X stairlift is available as both a new unit and a rental option, and installation typically takes 2-4 hours for straight models and 4-6 hours for curved models.

products.body_html: Handicare 1100 Straight Stairlift The New Handicare 1100 Straight, This is a ground breaking Straight Stairlift to Multicare with the narrowest stairlift rail in the world. The stair lift which is powered by Four Friction Motors, there is no toothtrack racking on the track and requires no oil or grease. The clean rails means there is no dirt or oil to worry about. It is safe to touch and ideal when children are around your home. The stairlift has a 22 stone weight limit and comes with a 3 year warranty, giving you peace of mind. The stylish vanilla leather upholstery not only perfectly compliments any home but is incredibly comfortable. The Handicare 1100 comes with a retractable belt and a slimline folding design. It is battery powered and comes with 2 remotes. The Handicare 1100 with the slimmest stairlift rail on the market, this makes it great for narrow staircases. This model also comes with the option of a powered swivel seat allowing easy exit at the top of the stairs. Power footrest option is also available by pressing a button the footrest lowers great for users with limited mobility. The 1100 Stair Lift has a full charge strip and is always on charge so the lift can be left anywhere along the track charging the batteries. We offer a nationwide service for new stairlift installations and repairs. We also cover London, Birmingham,  Manchester, Liverpool and more.

products.title: Access BDD Flow 2a Stairlift - Reconditioned
products.body_html:
The Flow 2 stair lift is the perfect solution for tight or limited staircases and comes in a wide choice of colours and fabric selections.

The Flow 2 stairlift is a specialised solution designed for customers who have trouble with narrow, curved, or complex staircases. Perfect for tight or limited staircases where space is a concern, the Flow 2 range of narrow stairlifts is the ideal thing to tackle even the trickiest setup and comes in a fantastic range of colours to suit any home. The width and angle of your staircase can vary significantly, but the Flow 2 stairlift can accommodate angles from -70 to 70 degrees, making it suitable for staircases with multiple bends, spiral configurations, and varying slopes. Unlike other stairlift models, the Flow 2 is the only model capable of fitting very narrow, curved, or spiral staircases, and it can be installed on either side of the staircase without attaching to the wall, as it is mounted directly to the stair treads. Customers appreciate the Flow 2 for its ability to fit on staircases as narrow as 61 centimetres, and for its smooth, comfortable operation and elegant, stylish design.

This exclusive feature ensures that all of our narrow stair lifts are flexible and versatile mobility solutions for any staircase, even those as narrow as 61 centimetres! The secret to this incredibly compact size lies with the rail of our narrow Flow 2 stair lifts, as it measures just 8 centimetres in diameter and runs especially close to the edge of your stairs so that space is maximised and the installation remains discreet. The Flow 2 stairlift is available as new, reconditioned, or rental models, providing flexible options for customers in Stockton-on-Tees and across the UK.

products.title: Handicare Simplicity Straight Slide Track
products.body_html:
The Slide Track is a groundbreaking solution available only from Handicare. This unique solution removes the need for a hinge; instead, the track moves up the staircase at the same time as the seat is moving, leaving the doorway at the base of your stairs unobstructed.
Similar to a powered hinge, the Slide Track works automatically when the toggle or remote control is activated. 

A Slide Track is slightly shorter than the length of your staircase. When you start to travel up the staircase, the track will move with you. The track will reach the top of your stairs before the stairlift, it will stop whilst your stairlift continues on its journey to the top where you can safely dismount. When you come downstairs, the track will travel down with you so you can dismount safely at the bottom. The Slide Track is fitted with safety sensors at either end, these will halt the track if it encounters an obstacle during use. Your stairlift will continue to move towards the obstacle if desired where, if safe to do so, you can remove the obstruction and continue your journey. Alternatively, the track and stairlift can be moved away from the obstruction. The Slide Track also offers safety benefits over a traditional hinged system by removing any risk of an object becoming caught in the hinge.

products.body_html:
Offering one of the slimmest stairlift tracks on the market, the Handicare 1000 straight stairlift is the perfect solution for anyone looking to achieve the smallest track intrusion into their staircase once everything is in place. We have a choice of six upholstery colours for this stairlift, as well as a whole range of additional features which hugely enhance your experience with it and help establish its reputation as one of the very best and most reliable stairlifts around. From folding footplates to the ability to swivel the seat at the top of the staircase, we’ve really thought of it all with this Handicare 1000 straight stairlift! What’s more, the super slim aluminium track of this stairlift has a hidden rack that offers two park points which charge the batteries both at the top and bottom of the stairs. You’ll never have to worry about not being able to get where you need to go, a benefit that definitely establishes this model as one of the most reliable stairlifts in the UK. The Handicare 1000 straight stairlift can also be combined with a powered hinge solution to prevent the track from obscuring any doorway at the base of the stairs.
